title: Poster Threads manual via Playwright / Manual Threads poster via Playwright
summary: ID: Tooling scripts/threads-poster baru: login interaktif, job JSON, dry-run headed, posting dengan delay manusiawi, dan report JSON. / EN: New scripts/threads-poster tooling: interactive login, JSON jobs, headed dry-run, human-like delayed posting, and JSON reports.
problem_before: ID: Belum ada cara manual tepercaya untuk memposting thread (main + reply) ke Threads dari repo ini. / EN: There was no trusted manual way to post threads (main plus replies) to Threads from this repo.
solution: ID: Modul auth/probe/thread/job/delays/locators/report/selectors + job contoh + RUNBOOK + script npm threads:auth/probe/post; auth.json + reports/ di-gitignore; E2E bertahap (dry-run, fast 1 reply, headless, full-speed) dengan fallback headed bila kena challenge. / EN: New auth/probe/thread/job/delays/locators/report/selectors modules plus an example job plus RUNBOOK plus threads:auth/probe/post npm scripts; auth.json plus reports/ gitignored; staged E2E (dry-run, fast 1-reply, headless, full-speed) with headed fallback on challenges.
reason: ID: Posting manual terkontrol (bukan bot terjadwal) untuk distribusi konten Threads dengan jeda aman. / EN: Controlled manual posting (not a scheduled bot) for Threads content distribution with safe delays.
user_impact: ID: Operator bisa posting thread via CLI dengan dry-run aman sebelum posting nyata. / EN: Operators can post threads via CLI with a safe dry-run before real posting.
tech_impact: ID: Dependensi dev Playwright baru; kredensial hanya lokal (auth.json gitignore); file .mjs tak ikut typecheck. / EN: New Playwright dev dependency; credentials stay local (gitignored auth.json); .mjs files are excluded from typecheck.
